# CAD license evidence copies

These files are unmodified license/notice texts from the exact CAD distributions
reviewed on 2026-11-05. They are not Summer implementation code and are not
relicensed under the project's MIT license. No upstream library source or binary
is vendored here.

| Directory | Origin | Texts copied |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `usd-brep-1.0.1/` | `usd_brep-1.0.1-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl` | All 17 dist-info license/notice files |
| `meshpy-2026.1.1/` | `meshpy-2026.1.1-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl` and `meshpy-2026.1.1.tar.gz` | Wheel `LICENSE` plus sdist `src/cpp/tetgen-LICENSE` (full AGPL) |
| `numpy-2.5.4/` | `numpy-2.5.4-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl` | All 17 dist-info license files |

Exact download URLs, package/archive hashes, member paths and every copied file's
SHA-256 are recorded in [the evidence inventory](../../docs/cad-dependencies.lock.json).
Original bytes, including Windows line endings, are retained using a scoped
`.gitattributes` rule. Do not format or translate these copies; place explanations
in the review document instead.

See [CAD_LICENSE_REVIEW.md](../../docs/CAD_LICENSE_REVIEW.md) for component licenses,
source evidence, actual distribution scope and unresolved binary redistribution
conditions. These copies preserve the available notices; they do not certify
that the upstream wheels supply every notice needed for repackaging, establish
commercial licenses, or satisfy all corresponding-source obligations.
